notes.title: PAX AUS 2016 and GHOST FIX/Patch 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Once again we have made it through another fantastic PAX in Melbourne! 

To all those who were able to come down we hope you had a great weekend and to those who came past our booth, we hope you had a blast! 

So during the PAX weekend we uploaded a Patch that was suppose to include everything that we were showcasing at PAX, however we accidentally uploaded the wrong version, one with an annoying bug where you are stuck playing as a ghost in all the levels instead of the character you chose. 

We have returned to the office and immediately noticed the fault and hope it did not effect your verdict of the game, we are updating the newer patch with a new feature that enables you to possess enemies after you have died to take on your friends. (This feature only serves to 'troll' friends and end the round sooner rather then just wandering as a ghost with nothing to do, we have features to implement to this game play in the future.) 

The archer now zooms in and slows your camera pivot speed when you are aiming, allowing you to get an easier shot in! 

We are sorry about this update accident and hope you enjoy these new updates! 


Special thanks to CallmePhipps for letting us know about this error 


Again, to those who came and saw us, we hope you enjoyed yourselves!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26316750/156543b4cdd627908e8a120cc24dce6d43c7107a.jpg[/img]

Osh- AstroBear Games

notes.title: 0.4.0 Patch Now Available!!
notes.notes:
Whats new from only 1 week ago?
Quiet a bit actually!

-Weapon Editing: Each character now has their own unique weapons that you can customize the variation of!
-Character Taunts: Each character now verbally taunts, giving them some funny lines!
-Dungeons have more environmental dangers such as fire pots and wall mounted flamethrower snake heads!
-The Mage has updated Spells and stats.
-Fireplaces now damage you.
-Added various sound fx
-Fixed minor issue where roof cealings where too high.
-Various others patches to improve gameplay feel

So they are just a couple of our fixes, however it's the Sword customizer that is well worth highlighting. Althought it is purely for looks, they will soon serve a greater purpose, weapon pieces will hold stats and effects that change how you can play the game!

So Check it out now, make some brutal swords, axes, hammers or staffs and show us what you think looks Epic, we have thousands of combinations for you to try out!

Have fun
Osh- AstroBear Games

notes.title: Dungeon Generator Update!!
notes.notes:
We did it!!

It took a bit of work but the dungeons are now LIVE and fully playable.
These dungeons have multiple pathways and rooms that are generated 100% randomly, so each dungeon will have a different layout. As more time passes we will add more dungeon rooms, until then there are currently over 20 variying rooms to explore, with random assorted objects and enemies in each!!

Along with the Dungeon update, we have overhauled our navigation system and fixed some game crashing bugs!

All coins collected will now be saved for later use!
There are a heap of other little updates throughout the game also!

So what are ye waiting for, check out the latest updates for Legends of Time!!


Osh- AstroBear Games

notes.title: Welcome to week one for Legends of Time on Steam Early Access
notes.notes:
Thank you to all who have supported the project thus far, it means a lot to us that you are already playing our game at such an early stage of development!

We have some big plans that we are keen to share with the community!

Firstly, we have been working hard on a Random Dungeon Generator, it's not 100% functional as of yet, but you can check out what we have so far. (Since the time of filming this version, some major bugs have been implimented, making the generator much more functional)

Check out the development video of the generator working at a viewable speed!
https://youtu.be/UBZ_vGg__wY


We are excited to also share with all that we will be at PAX AUS 2016. We intend on having the generator completed and available here on Steam for all to play before PAX itself!

After PAX AUS we are going to focus some attention on Multiplayer!! This means we will work towards getting networking happening. We are hoping that this will enable more players to play with each other who don't or can't play split screen.



Well thats the news for today, keep those swords swinging

Osh- AstroBear Games
